Class PopulateShipController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Client.UI.GUI.SceneControllers.GUIController
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Client.UI.GUI.SceneControllers.PopulateShipController
public class PopulateShipController extends GUIController
The PopulateShipController class manages the GUI interactions and logic required for populating the player's ship with lifeforms and handling the visual updates to the ship.
